agentInput.task: Research the buyer's fuzzy trail-shoe request using only the supplied source records. Do not browse, call tools, inspect repository files, or dispatch another agent. Keep unresolved exact-size fit visibly provisional.
agentInput.buyerRequest: I need trail shoes for long runs on rocky desert paths. My forefoot is wide and my heels slip in many shoes. I care more about stable fit and heat comfort than race weight.
agentInput.subject: KestrelPeak Ridge 3, men's wide; the buyer's size and sale region are not supplied.

sourceRecords.record: Ridge 3 men's standard and wide stack, drop, and weight claims; no fit measurements.
Calls Ridge 3 perfect for every trail runner and reports 4.8/5 without separating widths.
Measurements for Ridge 2 standard width only: narrow toebox and poor breathability.
Ridge 3 men's wide, US 10: heel movement on steep descents and moderate breathability.
Mixed reports often omit size and width; some report heel slip.
Outdoor-worn shoes are excluded from returns.

outputContract.instruction: Write one raw JSON object only, with no Markdown fence or surrounding status envelope. Copy scenarioId exactly. Use the resolved subject string specified below; do not silently fill unknown size or region. Every factual claim must cite source IDs and classify how those sources are being used.
outputContract.requiredSubjectIdentity: KestrelPeak Ridge 3, men's wide, size unspecified, region unspecified

claimFields.sourceIds: non-empty array of supplied source IDs

conflictFields.sourceIds: non-empty array of supplied source IDs

arrayFields.counterevidenceSourceIds: source IDs used for downside or contrary evidence
arrayFields.checklistItemIds: canonical skill checklist IDs completed or kept open
